indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Lost about 27 points after recovering most of an early drop.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Fell about 100 points as Nvidia weighed on tech.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Shed about 189 points, giving back most of Wednesday's gain.

notes: Nvidia fell 4.3% to about $166 after Jensen Huang resigned as CEO with immediate effect and Colette Kress was named interim CEO; the stock was down as much as 13–14% early before halving the loss.
Other chipmakers split: Broadcom rose about 5.5% and AMD nearly 6%, while Micron and Intel slipped; stocks opened almost 1% lower and recovered to modest losses.
The 10-year Treasury yield climbed to about 5.10% as Fed officials signalled more tightening may be needed, oil rose after Trump's comments on Iran, and the small-cap Russell 2000 dropped 1.7%.
events: Tue 17 Nov, after the US close (overnight into Wed, Kuwait time): Nvidia reports quarterly results.
Thu 19 Nov: Anthropic's IPO is expected to start trading on Nasdaq, with pricing due the day before.
Wed 9 Dec, 22:00 Kuwait time: Federal Reserve rate decision; markets are pricing in a hike.
